name: Product Ads
tagline: Runs product ads inside a daily budget, pausing losers and scaling winners
description: It starts from the photos and details you already have, building campaign drafts from them, then manages everything inside a fixed daily budget you set. Underperforming ads get paused and converting ones get scaled, following rules you agreed to in advance. Spend is reported from live numbers rather than estimates.
author: ColinMcDermott
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
